method: Exhaustive deterministic check of every parenthetical span, followed by pedagogical assessment of this one identical cue category: infinitive lemma for finite conjugation. This does not claim a fresh linguistic review of every example sentence.
checks: Exactly one parenthetical span, equal to the source lemma, in every Spanish prompt; no other brackets.
No target surface_form occurs verbatim anywhere in the prompt, including parenthetical lemma.
Every card retains a blank and its surface_form among answer options.
reason: The infinitive identifies which verb to conjugate; the learner still chooses person/tense/mood. None of the parenthetical lemmas supplies the target finite form.
